The opcode map: 47 of 256 bytes mean something

Every byte from 0 to 255 as a cell; green ones are TRI-27 opcodes. Press a byte: an undefined one decodes as NOP, decoding never fails.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/isa/ternary_encoding.t27: the TRI-27 instruction word as the pinned Trinity emulator decodes it (src/tri27/emu/decoder.zig at 976df517); every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
